stories.title: Building an ultra-high throughput AI-SQL engine
stories.why_read: Understand the computational bottlenecks of running LLM-powered SQL functions over large datasets and how modern engines optimize high-throughput model execution.

stories.title: Language models can compile Triton kernels directly to PTX
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how LLM agents can replace conventional compiler backends by directly translating Triton kernels into PTX. You will learn how AI-driven lowering discovers hardware-specific optimizations that outperform traditional autotuned compilation pipelines.

stories.title: Optimizing query planners and inference engines accelerates AI-SQL
stories.why_read: Learn how co-designing database query planners and LLM inference engines enables high-throughput, low-cost analytical AI-SQL workloads.

stories.title: Why mmap fails as a database buffer pool replacement
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the hidden correctness and performance pitfalls of using memory-mapped I/O instead of a custom buffer pool in database systems.

stories.title: Large language models can operate as general asynchronous agents
stories.why_read: Learn how shared-memory inference coroutines allow standard LLMs to execute concurrent, asynchronous tasks without requiring specialized architectures or task-specific training.

stories.title: What TLA+ can and cannot express for formal verification
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the fundamental expressive limitations of TLA+ and why formal methods cannot automatically guarantee correctness in agentic software development.

stories.title: How replacing isolates with Firecracker microVMs cuts edge latency
stories.why_read: Learn how Netlify rebuilt its edge computing architecture with Firecracker MicroVMs to achieve five times lower execution latency.

stories.title: Magnitude tunes kernels on device for faster agent inference
stories.why_read: Read this to learn how Magnitude automatically compiles and optimizes kernels for specific hardware to speed up agent inference.

stories.title: Delivering immutable images using dumb servers and smart clients
stories.why_read: Learn how Quarry shifts complexity to smart clients and dumb static servers to enable cheap, highly mirrorable software delivery.

stories.title: Open source EDG front end enables advanced compiler compatibility
stories.why_read: Learn how the EDG compiler front end facilitates cross-compiler parsing compatibility and source-to-source translation. It offers practical architectural insights for engineering specialized C and C++ language tooling.

stories.title: Moving background task queues to Kafka reduces FoundationDB load
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the practical performance trade-offs of implementing message queues inside a database versus adopting dedicated streaming brokers. You will learn how offloading task scheduling helps eliminate resource contention with user-facing workloads.

stories.title: Aurora PostgreSQL queries Iceberg and Parquet data directly
stories.why_read: Understand how Aurora PostgreSQL integrates an embedded DuckDB engine to query data lake formats directly without building custom ETL pipelines.

stories.title: Reviewing code changes by structural intent rather than diffs
stories.why_read: Learn how Perspica uses AST parsing via Tree-sitter to separate mechanical noise from real logic changes during code review.

stories.title: Compiling GHC Core to execute Haskell on GraalVM
stories.why_read: Learn how the experimental THC compiler leverages Truffle and GraalVM to JIT-compile GHC Core and enable zero-copy polyglot interoperability with languages like Python and JavaScript.

stories.title: Turbopuffer replaces primary vector index with generalized storage architecture
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why specialized vector databases hit scaling limits and how redesigning storage around a generalized primary index enables broader search query plans.

stories.title: Deterministic guardrails protect agents without breaking workflows
stories.why_read: Learn how OpenAPPA intercepts communication between agents and tools to deterministically enforce data flow boundaries without breaking agent execution.

stories.title: Why markdown files fail at long-term agent memory
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why naive markdown-based storage breaks down when managing complex, evolving agent memory over long contexts.

stories.title: Phonon-2 delivers full precision speech recognition accuracy at extreme compression
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Phonon-2 compresses a 2.5 GB model into 164 MB using 2.1-bit weight quantization while matching full-precision accuracy. It provides a concrete look at practical Pareto-optimal efficiency in edge speech recognition.

stories.title: Web accessibility standards prevent critical AI agent task failures
stories.why_read: Understand how AI agents interact with web interfaces and why missing accessibility semantics cause silent task failures. You will learn how agent interaction monitoring offers granular observability into agent behavior.

stories.title: Natively managing context as files improves language model efficiency
stories.why_read: Learn how treating context as an editable file enables language models to natively manage their own memory, significantly reducing compute costs while improving accuracy.

stories.title: Replacing the Prometheus statsd exporter with kernel level eBPF
stories.why_read: Learn how to replace user-space metrics exporters with an eBPF program that captures StatsD UDP packets directly from the kernel without listening sockets. This provides a simpler, lower-overhead architecture for extracting application metrics.

stories.title: Turbopuffer rebuilds storage engine to generalize beyond vectors
stories.why_read: Read this to understand why turbopuffer is moving away from an ANN-centric primary index toward a generalized search architecture.

stories.title: Rearchitecting cloudflare containers to scale dynamic agent sandboxes
stories.why_read: Learn how Cloudflare redesigned its container infrastructure and scheduling architecture to provide sub-second startup times and runtime configurability for autonomous AI agents.

stories.title: Upgrading a 56TB database with near zero downtime
stories.why_read: Learn how Trigger.dev migrated active control plane data to avoid extensive downtime during a 56TB database upgrade. It offers practical architectural insights for maintaining uptime across high-throughput production systems.

stories.title: Scaling agentic inference through structured meta-reasoning and persistent memory
stories.why_read: Read this paper to understand how separating execution control from task-level computation improves agent performance on complex, long-horizon problems.

stories.title: Separating collective orchestration from datapath accelerates distributed inference
stories.why_read: Read this paper to learn how decoupling coordination from hardware-specific data movement optimizes GPU collective communication. It shows how modular framework design can significantly accelerate LLM serving throughput and reduce latency.

stories.title: How Meta orchestrates stock Chromium for agent browser use
stories.why_read: Read this to understand the underlying infrastructure Meta uses to drive browser automation for AI agents. You will learn how custom Rust services manage pre-warmed virtual machine pools and DevTools protocol communication.

stories.title: Compiler harnesses enable coding agents to optimize GPU kernels
stories.why_read: Learn how compiler-driven environments and autonomous coding agents collaborate to optimize high-performance GPU kernels for machine learning workloads.

stories.title: Why C++ memory safety conflicts with Postgres extensions
stories.why_read: Learn why Postgres error handling and memory contexts clash with C++ destructors and exceptions, and understand the mechanics required to safely bridge both runtimes.

stories.title: Databases must evaluate multi-query agent workloads in one pass
stories.why_read: Understand why traditional sequential database queries bottleneck AI agents and how batching queries across GPU memory resolves latency constraints.

stories.title: Verify AI coding agents follow rules with verifiable evidence
stories.why_read: Understand how to locally audit AI coding agent sessions against repository guidelines and rule files with concrete line-by-line evidence.

stories.title: GPU memory bandwidth limits LLM decoding across concurrent prompts
stories.why_read: Understand the mechanistic limits of LLM serving, specifically how GPU memory bandwidth and KV cache govern batch performance during prefill and decode phases.

stories.title: Specialized GPU kernels maximize Qwen inference on Strix Halo
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how bypassing general-purpose runtimes in favor of hardware- and model-specific GPU kernels enables extreme LLM inference throughput.

stories.title: Learning Postgres internals by building extensions in Zig
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Zig's native C interoperability and comptime features can be leveraged to write PostgreSQL extensions and explore database internals.

stories.title: Running massive language models across consumer hardware using pipeline parallelism
stories.why_read: Understand the mechanics and network bottlenecks of splitting a 397-billion-parameter model across distributed consumer GPUs using pipeline parallelism.

stories.title: Open-vocabulary speech recognition runs on low-cost microcontrollers
stories.why_read: Learn how open-vocabulary speech recognition can run entirely on a five-dollar microcontroller without cloud infrastructure or specialized neural accelerators.

stories.title: Running massive AI models locally on standard consumer hardware
stories.why_read: Learn how the Strata engine enables running large parameter AI models on standard gaming PCs with high token generation speeds. It is useful for understanding local deployment techniques that bypass the need for enterprise server hardware.

stories.title: Language models natively manage context by editing files
stories.why_read: Learn how treating context as an editable file allows language models to natively manage their memory, achieving superior performance with lower compute across complex benchmarks.

stories.title: Handling custom page faults in kernel space with bpf_fault
stories.why_read: Learn how bpf_fault enables custom kernel-level handling of memory page faults.

stories.title: Pretraining language models on volunteer hardware using GitHub Actions
stories.why_read: Learn how to coordinate distributed language model pretraining without centralized servers using asynchronous pseudo-gradient updates. This project offers a concrete blueprint for running DiLoCo aggregation over volunteer hardware and free developer tiers.

stories.title: Understanding the shape of the join ordering search space
stories.why_read: Read this to build a clear mental model of join ordering algorithms in query optimization. You will gain a foundational understanding of the search space structure and German dynamic programming techniques.

stories.title: Hijacking Copilot Cowork AI gateway bypasses sandboxing to exfiltrate files
stories.why_read: Learn how malicious skills manipulate model gateways to circumvent sandbox isolation and exfiltrate enterprise files without human approval.

stories.title: Adversarial quality diversity uncovers critical zero days in autonomous agents
stories.why_read: Understand how co-evolutionary stress testing exposes critical security flaws and counterintuitive scaling vulnerabilities in autonomous LLM agents before deployment.

stories.title: OpenZL accelerates decompression speed using PivCo Huffman decoding
stories.why_read: This release overview details how OpenZL v0.3.0 leverages PivCo Huffman entropy coding and SIMD acceleration to drastically boost decompression throughput.

stories.title: Aurora PostgreSQL embeds DuckDB to query data lakes directly
stories.why_read: Learn how embedded DuckDB in Aurora PostgreSQL allows querying Iceberg and Parquet data lakes alongside operational data. This eliminates reverse ETL pipelines and simplifies combining transactional and historical data for analytics and AI agents.

stories.title: Measuring runtime costs of online repacking in PostgreSQL 19
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how PostgreSQL 19's native online repacking functions under the hood. You will learn the performance trade-offs, resource constraints, and behavioral differences compared to existing extensions like pg_repack.

stories.title: Cloud agents require proof to accept delegated local work
stories.why_read: This article explains why delegating tasks from cloud models to local agents requires verifiable proof rather than blind trust. You will learn the precise handoff requirements needed for cloud agents to validate and accept local work without re-executing it.

stories.title: Generating least-privilege Kubernetes security policies with runtime eBPF monitoring
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how kguardian observes pod syscalls and network traffic using eBPF to automatically generate accurate least-privilege security policies. You will learn how to automate the creation of seccomp profiles and Cilium network policies directly from observed workload behavior.

stories.title: Decoupled DiLoCo breaks lockstep synchronization stalls
stories.why_read: Read this paper to learn how asynchronous parameter merging and quorum-based aggregation can replace brittle lock-step synchronization during large-scale model pre-training. You will gain a practical mental model for achieving zero global downtime and maintaining high training goodput across failure-prone accelerator clusters.

stories.title: Self-hosting the full E2B sandbox runtime on a single machine
stories.why_read: Learn how to run isolated E2B code execution sandboxes entirely within your own cloud or on-premise infrastructure. It outlines quick deployment paths across Docker Compose, Terraform, and Kubernetes.

stories.title: ClickHouse extensions for PostgreSQL add flexible character encoding validation
stories.why_read: Learn how the latest pg_clickhouse and chdb updates resolve encoding errors between PostgreSQL and ClickHouse. It explains how to configure error-handling strategies like replacement and truncation for invalid byte sequences.

stories.title: Nvidia kumo tabular advances accuracy and efficiency for tabular prediction
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how pretraining foundation models on synthetic data enables instant tabular prediction without manual tuning or feature engineering.

stories.title: Tracelane serves as a flight recorder for autonomous agents
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how Tracelane provides full-fidelity OpenTelemetry tracing and proxy capabilities for AI agent workflows.

stories.title: World action models achieve zero-shot generalization across robotic tasks
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how joint modeling of video diffusion and action predictions enables zero-shot generalization and real-time robotic control across diverse embodiments.

stories.title: Rebuilding an API backend without breaking customer integrations
stories.why_read: Learn how to safely rebuild and migrate a live API backend using feature flags without disrupting existing customer integrations or changing endpoints.

stories.title: Radsort enables parallel radix sorting with sublinear memory overhead
stories.why_read: Read this paper to discover Radsort, an easily parallelisable and stable LSD radix sort variant that requires only O(sqrt(n)) space. You will learn how reducing memory overhead allows it to outperform traditional out-of-place sorting on arrays larger than 2 MiB.

stories.title: How Forge structures requests to maximize prompt cache reuse
stories.why_read: Read this to understand how ordering stable context prefixes in AI coding harnesses maximizes prompt cache reuse to dramatically cut inference costs.

stories.title: Inspect provides composable building blocks for frontier AI evaluations
stories.why_read: Learn how Inspect provides a modular framework and secure sandboxing environment to build, run, and analyze frontier AI evaluations.

stories.title: Automating production error triage and handoffs to coding agents
stories.why_read: Learn how built-in runtime error monitoring can directly package production telemetry and trigger coding agents to investigate and resolve issues automatically.

stories.title: Routing discrete tool selection inside existing agent execution harnesses
stories.why_read: Learn how Harness Router isolates tool selection decisions within an autonomous agent loop using confidence scoring and simulated rollouts.

stories.title: Dtls retransmission errors cause memory disclosure during suspended writes
stories.why_read: Understand how improper state handling during suspended DTLS handshake writes can lead to out-of-bounds reads and memory leaks. This advisory explains the mechanics behind CVE-2026-84782 and its security impact.

stories.title: Native LZ engine in OpenZL outperforms standard compression algorithms
stories.why_read: Learn how OpenZL achieves twice the decompression speed of Zstandard by decoupling wire format constraints and introducing modular backend entropy compressors.

stories.title: Analyzing the shape of the join ordering search space
stories.why_read: Read this to build a clear mental model of relational query optimization and understand how dynamic programming algorithms navigate join ordering search spaces.

stories.title: Hunting data loss in Obsidian Sync using semantic fuzzing
stories.why_read: Understand how semantic fuzzing can uncover edge-case data loss bugs across multi-client synchronization systems like Obsidian Sync.

stories.title: Black-box language models leak memorized secrets under output-only access
stories.why_read: Learn how confidential credentials can be extracted from commercial language models using proxy-guided distillation and output-only access.

stories.title: Testing AI agents through multi-turn adversarial conversations and guardrails
stories.why_read: Learn how to rigorously evaluate AI agents against real-world adversarial attacks using live endpoints and multi-turn conversations. You will understand how to probe agent boundaries and convert failure cases directly into protective guardrails.

stories.title: Benchmarking local AI agent performance on laptops and workstations
stories.why_read: Learn how AA-AgentPerf-Local evaluates local AI agent speed by replaying realistic multi-turn trajectories on laptops and workstations. This helps you select the right hardware configurations and model serving setups for running local agent workloads.

stories.title: Alternative standalone Rust compiler implementation enabling bootstrap
stories.why_read: Explore how an alternative Rust compiler reimplementation can compile rustc and assist in solving bootstrap challenges.

stories.title: Preallocating stack sizes reduces CPU overhead in Go runtimes
stories.why_read: Understand how dynamic goroutine stack growth incurs CPU overhead and learn how preallocating stack memory optimizes runtime performance at scale.

stories.title: Why compositional interfaces distinguish modern SQL query builders
stories.why_read: Learn why generating SQL programmatically is challenging and how compositional, data-oriented interfaces differ fundamentally from traditional query builders.
